adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the condition for setting `slug` during organization creation was inverted. It changed from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, meaning when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is false the created organization no longer gets a `slug` at all. Also, when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is true, the code now sets both `slug` and `metadata.requestedSlug` (previously only `requestedSlug`), which is a behavior change and likely bypasses any “requested slug” approval/flow implied by the metadata field.
